name: Johan Martinson
title: PhD Student Researcher and Software Engineer
summary: Fullstack software developer and PhD candidate. My research focuses on automating the complex process of featurization in software systems using large language models to introduce and manage variability, making code adaptable to diverse user requirements.

positionsOfTrust.title: Head of Education, H-section Student Union Board
positionsOfTrust.description: Served as Head of Education on the H-section's student union board at Chalmers. Responsibilities included overseeing how students in the section could influence their education through student representatives, and giving those representatives a solid basis for voicing their fellow students' opinions. As Head of Education on the board, I also held the role of chairman of SnH (the Study Council, H-section). The chairman of SnH convenes meetings, assigns tasks to the group for events, promotion and course evaluations, and manages the group's finances.

positionsOfTrust.title: PR-group Leader & Sponsorship Strategy Lead
positionsOfTrust.description: Responsible for the overarching marketing plan and leader of the PR group. Led the strategy for obtaining sponsorships. Second year, worked as audio engineer during the shows.

positionsOfTrust.title: Board Member
positionsOfTrust.description: Recruited new players, presented the club to Chalmers Student Union members, and arranged activities during the reception and throughout the season. Set up G Suite and built a new website for the club.

positionsOfTrust.title: Study Council Representative
positionsOfTrust.description: Represented the Computer Engineering programme in the H-section study council.
